$comment: Generated by tools/ont-check/gen-contracts.mjs from the ontology. Do not edit by hand.

concept.title: Concept
concept.description: Something in the product that people talk about, with one permanent ID and one definition row.

id.description: class.name in lowercase; a field or a relation adds its entity, field.loan.due-date. Never changes.

kind.description: One of the classes the configuration lists, in the order rows are grouped; by default entity, field, relation, derived, concept, rule, invariant, hook, action, view.

term.description: The name people use. It may change; the ID does not.

type.description: For fields and relations only: a type from the neutral vocabulary.

definition.description: What the concept is, in one or two sentences. Tooltips, reference pages and contracts quote it.

entity.description: The entity a field or relation belongs to, named in its ID.

retired-id.title: Retired ID
retired-id.description: An ID that had to change, kept so that the decision log, which is never edited, still resolves.

replacedBy.description: The concept that replaces it; none for a removed concept.

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: One choice about the product, with its reason and the alternatives rejected.

status.description: Accepted entries are final; a tentative one may change without a new entry, and removing the flag is an entry.

choice.description: What was chosen, precisely enough to implement.

why.description: The reason, including what went wrong before.

rejected.description: Each alternative with its reason in brackets.

title.description: One line that states the decision, not the topic: "No money fines", not "Fines".

supersedes.description: Earlier entries this one replaces, each whole, named on a Supersedes: line.

implementation-row.title: Implementation row
implementation-row.description: A claim that a concept exists in the product, with the files and a note on what is partial.

files.description: Paths of the files that realise the concept.

divergence.title: Divergence
divergence.description: A place where the product does something the target does not want.

description.description: What the product does instead, and the ticket or decision that will settle it.

mockup-element.title: Mockup element
mockup-element.description: A meaningful element of the mockup, labelled with a concept by data-ont.

concept.description: The concept the element stands for.

map-row.title: Map row
map-row.description: A row of the UI-to-ontology map: one mockup element and its concept.

shows.description: What the element shows, on this screen.

doesNotDo.description: What the element deliberately does not do.

check.title: Check
check.description: A case with data that must hold for any implementation, in the product's terms.

proof.description: auto when a test implements it, manual when only a person or an agent with the product can.

test.title: Test
test.description: Code that implements checks and starts its title with their IDs.

suite.description: The suite the test belongs to.

test-suite.title: Test suite
test-suite.description: A kind of test the team runs, such as unit or end-to-end, and the classes it must prove.

cover.description: The classes whose implemented concepts the suite must prove.

ticket.title: Ticket
ticket.description: A slice of the gap: what to build now, within which limits.

whyNow.description: Why this slice comes before the rest of the gap.

outOfScope.description: What not to build, though it is target too.

preAuthorized.description: Permissions the agent would otherwise stop and ask for.

dependsOn.description: Slices that must be done first.

agent-rules.title: Agent rules
agent-rules.description: The section of the agents' instructions that says what else to update when something changes, and what to run.

contract.title: Contract
contract.description: A JSON Schema per entity, generated from the types of its fields and relations.

doc-section.title: Doc section
doc-section.description: A hand-written section of a page for people, anchored to what it explains.

stamp.description: A short hash of what the section relies on for each concept it explains, the term, type, definition and the notes that name it, as it was when the section was last reread.

explains.description: The concepts and checks the section explains.

set.description: The doc set the page belongs to.

doc-set.title: Doc set
doc-set.description: A set of pages for one audience, and the classes it must explain.

cover.description: The classes whose concepts the set must explain.

scope.description: Whether the set explains what is built or the whole target.

reference-page.title: Reference page
reference-page.description: A page that only restates the ontology and the checks, generated, never edited.
